title: Protocol documents
text: Every document of the protocol, readable by people and by AI.

items.title: The reader opens any protocol document on the site
items.text: The documents are read from the protocol's GitHub repository when a page is drawn, so a new or changed document appears on the site without a deployment.
items.acceptance: A document added to the repository opens on the site without a rebuild.

items.title: An AI reads the whole protocol in one English text
items.text: llms-full.txt gives every document in English at any address of the site; the Russian version is for people only.
items.acceptance: llms-full.txt holds every document and is the same English text on /en and /ru.
